records.name: operates
records.rationale: Existing derived material relation retained; derivation through a grounded operation context and endpoint scope need review.
records.required_evidence: Document derivation rule, operation relator, participant roles and multiplicities.

g3_2d_review.truthmaker: FacilityOperation relator mediates OperatingOrganizationRole and OperatedFacilityRole; both specialize Organization and Facility.
g3_2d_review.cardinality: Each FacilityOperation has >=1 operating organization and exactly 1 operated facility; do not infer global organization/facility limits.
g3_2d_review.temporal_scope: For an operation relator r, derive operates(o,f,t) only when r valid at t and r mediates matching o and f; retain provenance of r.
g3_2d_review.negative_example: An Organization and Facility co-occurring in a source record without FacilityOperation must not yield operates.
g3_2d_review.recommendation: Keep native derived Material; implement explicit temporal derivation and provenance in a separate OWL/rule/SHACL integration, because current OWL is annotation-only.
